relationships.subject: AP2α2
relationships.evidence_quote: These data suggested that DRG neuronal AP2α2 knockdown disrupted neuroplastic processes necessary for both thermal and mechanical sensitivity during inflammation.

key_findings: AP2α2 is preferentially expressed in CGRP+/IB4- nociceptors; its knockdown reduced PKA-induced hyperexcitability and inflammatory pain behaviors.
A single lipidated AP2 inhibitor peptide injection accelerated recovery from CFA thermal hypersensitivity, with sex-dependent kinetics.
